name: Abigor
subtitle: THE ARCHO-TYRANNUS
flavor: The crowned amalgam of ancient, forgotten beings. The white flesh it wears is said to be the remains of the previous king of this territory. Its shrill scream is known to shatter obsidian, and crack the soul.
attacks: Draw three 3x3 boxes on the map. The next time Abigor takes damage, each box deals 8 damage to any players within them. Abigor may have 5 active boxes at any one time, and boxes disappear after they inflict damage.
Bleed:2 to all adjacent player characters, Pin:1 any one adjacent character, and summon 2 Swarm minions within 2 spaces of Abigor
Charge:8, if Abigor collides with a player, deal remaining Charge+5 dam- age, Push:2 and stop movement
agnosia_text: Burst:3 for 5 damage, Pin:1 all adjacent characters, and immediately enter AEGIS.
special_text: At the start of their turn, Abigor may devour an adjacent minion to enter AEGIS State. In AEGIS State, Abigor takes flight and gains +1 Speed, ignores any terrain restrictions, and is treated as having Elevation +3. AEGIS ends when Abigor ends their turn.

name: The Horned One
flavor: A brutish beast, barely aware of the war it was bred for. Only its violent nature and lack of control keeps its subordinates in line.
attacks: Charge:5, if Keras collides with a player, deal the remaining Charge as damage and Push:2. If a player collides with a wall, object, or another unit after the Push, deal an additional 3 damage.
Burst:3, Damage:5
agnosia_text: Deal all remaining HP as damage to the attacker. Unit dies immediately afterwards.

name: Bloodtongues
flavor: A winged creature subjected to SYNCRASIS techno-organic fusion experiments. Its head has been replaced with a mycelial warcolony, and its natural defenses hijacked by warfare aligned bio-algorithms.
attacks: Range:4, Deal 3 damage to all creatures within Burst:2 and convert the spaces they are standing on to Scorch terrain. Scorch terrain deals 1 damage when a unit leaves that space.
Target:1, Range:3, Damage:4, Slow:3
agnosia_text: Select one miniboss unit within Range:5 and merge with them. Add this unit’s remaining HP and grant the target miniboss the following ability: Target 2 units within Range:3, deal 2 damage inflict Slow:2

name: Skinthief
flavor: Once, all matter was one. All living creatures existed in a primordial swamp indistinguishable from each other. This bipedal macrophage colony runs an emulation suite in senseless adulation of this state of being.
attacks: Create a Linked terrain tile on an adjacent space. Only 3 Linked tiles created by Skinthief units may be active in any one TACCOM encounter. If a Skinthief attempts to place a 4th Linked Tile, they must remove one placed earlier. If an enemy unit besides the Skinthief uses a Linked tile, all Skinthieves on the map gain one of the unit's attacks during their next turns. Linked tiles may be moved between as if they were adjacent.
Target one adjacent unit. Deal 1D6 damage and create a Burst:2 Shaded:1 effect
centered on the target. This shade does not move with the target and vanishes at the start of this unit's next turn, or when they are defeated, whichever happens first.
agnosia_text: Select a previously deployed unit from this or an allied faction. Turn into that unit. Retain this unit's current HP, and remove any Agnosia moves from the unit being transformed into.
special_text: Whenever a Skinthief is within a Shaded space, they may end their turn and become invisible. While invisible, this unit may not move, attack, trigger Provoke, or otherwise interact with the current TAC- COM engagement. Remove their token or marker from the map but remember where they are. When HELLPIERCERS move within Burst:3 of this unit, interrupt their movement, become visible and, reposition within Range:2. If you reposition adjacent to the HELLPIERCER, deal 1D6 damage.

name: Wall-Strider
flavor: Life itself is too progressive for the Syncrasian doctrine.
attacks: Wall:5, Push:1, Damage:6. Place Obsta- cle:1 on every space a unit was pushed from.
Range:6, Damage:6, Seeking. You may choose to deal +2 Damage and gain Ar- mor:2 if this attack is made while adjacent to an Obstacle or allied unit. Remove the Obstacle or Allied unit from the field.
agnosia_text: Grant all allies within Range:3 Armor:1 instantly. Grant Armor:1 to all adjacent allied units at the end of this unit's turn.
special_text: Unit is immune to any effects that force movement, such as Push or Pull.

name: Forgotten Claws
flavor: Smarter than they seem, Kleptes are used to track down escaped souls. Alone, they feign injury and weakness, only revealing their true strength when it’s too late.
attacks: Deal 2 damage to an adjacent creature.
special_text: Forgotten Claw Swarms gain an additional 3 Speed.

name: Howling Primordia
flavor: A sentient virus brewed in primordial cauldrons; an unstoppable wave of anti-growth, convincing the motes of life in the air to return to a more homogeneous age.
attacks: Deal 1 damage to an adjacent creature.
special_text: When moving at least 1 space, you may spend 1 Speed per move to create a new Howling Primordia and immediately add them to your Swarm. Additionally, you may use your action to Swarm with adjacent Obstacles, adding their value to the Swarm’s total HP.

name: Wormrot
flavor: Further, further into the dark, before jellyfish and worms and dirt and trees. Before eyeballs and bacteria. Before the slimes and the oozes and the soup. Find the beginning. Find purity.
attacks: Arc:3, Damage:2. Inflict Slow:1 on all targeted units.
special_text: Unit may target Obstacles with their attacks, increasing the Obstacle’s value by the damage inflicted.

name: The Little Ghosts
flavor: All living things have pneumatic potential, but microbes and pondscum lack the mass to cultivate it. This amalgam of disembodied bacterial souls seeks gnosis in the basest forms.
special_text: Unit has no standard attack. They may move through Obstacles without spending Speed. When they do, the Obstacle gains Countdown:3. When Countdown hits 0, Obstacle explodes, creating a Burst:2 space and dealing damage equal to its original value to all units. If the obstacle is destroyed before Countdown hits 0, it explodes in Burst:1, dealing damage equal to the current Countdown to all units.

name: Maneater
flavor: A bushel of enormous pre-jurassic trees. Their trunks are drastically more flexible than they seem, allowing them to attack nearby foes.
special_text: Spawning - At the end of the round, Maneater gains a Charge. On the GM’s turn, they may spend 1 Charge to spawn a SYNCRASIS minion, or 5 Charges to spawn a Miniboss.
Fighting Birth - When Maneater Spawns, deal 2 damage and Push:1 to all adjacent creatures.

name: Aamon
subtitle: THE ROT BLOSSOM
flavor: Scholars of Hell speculate Aamon may exist at the center of a vast network of fungal spores and tendrils, ruling over their loamy masses through sheer force of will.
attacks: When next to or moving near an adjacent wall, Aamon may launch off of it moving up to 10 spaces in a single direction. Any units along the line of Aamon’s movement take 3 damage.
Range:5 Damage:5. Deal an additional 2 damage to any player within 2 spaces of the target.

Charge:8, if Aamon collides with a player character, deal 5 damage, end movement and increase Aamon’s Elevation by 1. Subsequent attacks may use this skill again, further increasing elevation. If a turn passes without using this skill, Aamon returns to the ground.
agnosia_text: Aamon ascends into the air and immediately makes an attack from Elevation:3. On the start of its next turn, it returns to ground level. The turn after that, it ascends to Elevation:3 again before any actions are taken. This pattern of moving from the ground to Elevation:3 on alternating turns continues until Aamon is killed or the fight is over.
special_text: When Aamon drops to the ground from Elevation:3 they deal 5 damage in Burst:3.

name: The Petty Tyrant
flavor: The knotted protuberances on its brow compel its followers to do its bidding. Soldiers who resist are made a violent example to other would-be dissidents.
attacks: Range:8 Damage:5. If this attack’s target is enclosed on all sides by a single swarm, the Swarm may make an immediate free attack against the same target.
3 Damage. If a Swarm or minion is within 3 squares, this unit may command them to immediately move 4 spaces or their Speed, whichever is lower.
agnosia_text: Any units with the Swarm tag immediately move up to their Speed to surround this unit. Each Swarm unit between the unit and any attackers provides Cover:1.

name: The Star Shooter
flavor: A mushroom sits atop their head, forming a brim which cuts across their face, framing their menacing visage. Beneath a tattered and flowing overcoat it holsters two dueling pistols.
attacks: Range:6, Burst:1, Damage:3. If a target in Burst is at equal or lower elevation to the Star Shooter, they may cause up to one target who meets that criteria to increase the level of their elevation by one.
Range:1, Damage:2, Push:4. If the target collides with any other units, damage is dealt per the Push rules, but to the unit collided with instead of the target unit.

Range:6, Damage:2. If this attack targets a unit at elevation higher than the Star Shooter’s current elevation, that unit immediately descends until they collide with the ground. Deal damage to the target equal to 2 + the units of elevation moved during the descent.
agnosia_text: The Star Shooter may target up to two units within Burst:4 and immediately force them to increase their level of elevation by two. This unit may then make an attack without consuming their action for the turn.
special_text: The Star Shooter deals an additional point of damage on attacks which target a unit at a higher level of elevation than them.

name: The Cultivator
flavor: This fungal creature is covered in recesses lined with devouring teeth which bubble with rendering acids. The cultivator concerns itself with repurposing the component parts of all it consumes.
attacks: Range:1 Damage:2. This unit may force a minion to move one space. If it ends its movement adjacent to this unit, the minion is devoured and this attack deals 2 additional Damage.
Line:3 Pull:1 Damage:1. If a unit pulled by this attack is made adjacent to The Cultivator, the pulled unit gains Pin:1.
agnosia_text: This unit produces a wave of digestive acids in Cone:3. Units in range take 1 damage and Poisoned:1. Any units which are pinned take Poison:3. Any units which are already under the effect of poison double their current poison value.
special_text: When this unit attacks a unit which is pinned, inflict Poison:2

name: The Reflector
flavor: A hulking demon that utilizes two calcified mushrooms as twin aegises. Scars run across their body, a marker of battlefield prowess and disasters averted for their allies.
attacks: Range:2, Burst:1, Damage:3
This unit may forgo attacking this round and instead gain:

When a unit within Range:6 becomes the target of an attack, this unit may move up to 6 spaces and take damage in the targeted unit’s stead. If the attacking unit’s position is within Range:2 of the target, you may trigger Averting Pal- isade.
agnosia_text: Gain Charge:3. When taking damage for another unit you may spend one Charge to nullify all damage on that attack. You may spend 2 Charges to nullify all damage and force the attacking unit to gain 2 elevation. If the elevated unit has no means to maintain their elevation, they will begin falling at the start of their next turn.
special_text: When attacked by a unit within Range:2 of this unit, it may force the attacking unit to gain one elevation. If the elevated unit has no means to maintain their elevation, they will begin falling at the start of their next turn.

name: The Cannoneers
flavor: These demons are well known for their tendency to throw each other bodily through the air. Casualties stemming from this ritual are seen as no particular loss to them. Their rot will blossom hundreds of sporecaps.
attacks: Deal 2 damage to an adjacent creature
special_text: Make an attack at up to Range:6, leaving one minion in a space adjacent to the target.

name: The Supplicants
flavor: Humans, Demons, and other Beings Who Might Know brought under the self-annihilating influence of Henosis. When not under orders, they shamble aimlessly, but snap into preternaturally quick and powerful movement when commanded. They look at you as though extending an invitation to let go and join them.
attacks: Deal 1 damage to an adjacent target
special_text: If the Supplicants have Swarmed, attacks inflict Pin:1 on their targets.

name: The Packhounds
flavor: The Kynigesion are fauna native to Hell come in contact with the all-consuming tide of Henosis. Twisted fungal growths erupt from their flesh and spread spores with their shaking and leaping. Even among the beasts of Hell, the packhounds are especially ferocious.
attacks: Deal 2 damage to an adjacent Creature
special_text: When a packhound attacks a unit to whom another packhound is adjacent, double damage dealt.

name: The Stepping Stones
flavor: Soft-bodied fungal soldiers deployed to support the forces of Henosis. While The stepping stones remain unmoved, all who come into contact with them are made skyborne.
special_text: The stepping stones have no standard attack. Any time another unit deals damage to them while Swarming, the damaging unit has their current elevation increased by one. If the elevated unit has no means to maintain their elevation, they will begin falling at the start of their next turn. The force distributed to launch another unit creates a kinetic shockwave dealing 3 damage to all creatures within burst one of the Swarm.

name: The Birth-Cap
flavor: Low to the ground and meters wide in diameter, this enormous fungal outgrowth always smells of blood-soaked soil and sounds of wailing pain. Tags: Spawner, Immobile
special_text: Spawning - At the end of the round, The Birth-Cap gains a Charge. On the GM’s turn, they may spend 1 Charge to spawn a Henosis minion, or 5 Charges to spawn a miniboss.
Heinous Stench: When the Birth-Cap Spawns, all units within 4 squares gain Poison:3.

name: Rot Conflagrator
flavor: At its core, a pulsing vein of Aamon's will churns, assuming control as his foot soldiers are latched to the fortifications of his ever expanding armies. They will accept no one soldier twice, even as they weep, pulling free their flesh that they might be united once again.
special_text: Manned: The Rot Conflagrator must be operated by an adjacent unit. Use of the Rot Conflagrator takes that unit’s action to operate.

name: Spore Hub
flavor: Love and hate intermingle so sweetly on the road to the sublimation of self. The itch to strike out at the object of your affection is natural. Good. You know the Rot Blossom's love in this way. Alas, when you strike out at him, it is your flesh carved with manic love.
special_text: When an allied unit passes within Range:3 it gains Transference:1.
Spore Hub has Compel:3 eternally.

name: Haagenti
subtitle: THE NEVER-SATED
flavor: A gaunt creature in the shape of a humanoid woman, her elongated hands and amorphous feet perpetually bleed a bitumen-like substance called ANATHEMA that drains the life out of everything it touches.
attacks: Target:1, Damage:10, Transference:8
Line:8 Damage:10, subtract 1 damage for each space between Haagenti and the target. Any impaled characters are Pulled:3 towards her.
Blob:7 anywhere in line of sight. Deal 3 damage and Mark targetted squares. On her next turn, marked squares become a pool of ANATHEMA.
agnosia_text: Burst:3 for 5 damage, create a 3x3 Box around Haagenti of ANATHEMA. In addition, any instance of damage dealt by

ANATHEMA on the map while she is in AGNOSIA creates a special Sloucher minion with HP equal to the amount of damage dealt. It is placed directly adjacent to the victim by the GM and its sole desire in the world is to be consumed again by Haagenti, restoring her whatever HP it has when it makes it to a space adjacent to her.
special_text: When Haagenti moves, she bleeds a trail of ANATHEMA behind her. ANATH- EMA remains in play until Haagenti is defeated. Players touching ANATHEMA at any point immediately take 3 damage and gain Slow:1 as the life is drained from their bones. ANATHEMA does not effect AUTOPHYES units.

name: The Engine
flavor: A colossus of hellsteel and malice, it rumbles forward on massive, tank-crushing treads and lashes out with a mouth of constantly rotating, bloodstained drill nodules. The crimson leaking out of the hematic pistons let you know just what fuels this abomination.
attacks: Line:2, Damage:5 as the drills focus their efforts.
Cone:2, Damage:3 as the drills splay out, Bleed:2.
agnosia_text: The Engine burrows immediately. Create three markers on the map of rumbling stones and cracking earth. Next full turn, the Engine emerges from the one that’ll be the most annoying for the players, doing Burst:2 Damage:7 to everything around it.

name: Harvester
flavor: This millipede-like creature is a common sight on battlefields and graveyards in AU- TOPHYES territory. No two of its uncountable limbs are alike, yet all operate in concert to pluck and rip out more arms, legs, tails, and other parts from corpses to hastily attach to its wiggling body.
attacks: Charge:6, Damage:6, deal 3 damage to any units adjacent to the charge path.
Target:X, Range:1, Damage:3. This attack can be used up to 5 times, selecting a different target each time if possible.
agnosia_text: The Harvester splits in half like a flatworm, creating two Scale:1 Harvesters with otherwise identical attacks and Speed, with the remaining HP split between both. Both Harvester halves need to be killed for this enemy to be considered dead.
special_text: When the Harvester unit becomes active in a battle, any defeated unit leaves behind a Corpse token. If the Harvester runs over a Corpse in the course of its turn, remove the Corpse and add 1 damage to the Harvesters next attack. After the attack, the damage returns to base level. Players can attack these corpses to remove them.

name: Extractors
flavor: The once-human and the never-born lurch in packs toward their next harvest site. Cracked gas masks and punctured armour conceal sallow flesh pocked with metal buboes. They lash out with hands of steel and bone pulled into the shape of tools.
attacks: Damage:3, Range:1 to one adjacent creature.
special_text: Extractors may forgo their turn to observe a target in line of sight and form the perfect weapon from their limbs. For the rest of the combat encounter, their attacks do double damage against that target.

name: Whalers
flavor: Fast moving quadrupeds resembling a large decapitated wolf’s body with too many joints, their spines can be launched forth, acting as a harpoon made of bone and sinew. The spinal cord used as the fishing line feels everything. If this thing had a head, it would be screaming.
attacks: Line:10 harpoon attack dealing 3 damage, Pull:3 toward Whaler to the first character in the line.
special_text: Creatures damaged by Whalers are impaled and count as Slow and Bleeding until this enemy is killed or they are no longer within Range:10. The Whaler cannot strike again while it has a creature impaled

name: Sloucher
flavor: Semi-motile spill of caustic sludge that lurches forward, always in search of another meal. Another MEAL. Another M E A L
special_text: Adjacent AUTOPHYES can consume an adjacent Sloucher or Sloucher Swarm to heal damage equal to the Sloucher’s HP.

name: Bulwarks
flavor: The elites in Haagenti’s personal service, these faceless, armoured opponents are far taller than they should be, never seem to tire, and breathe a toxic, fetid fog that even turns the heads of all but the most desiccated wastelander.
attacks: Shock:1, Damage:5
special_text: Ending a turn adjacent to a Bulwark incurs Poison:2 to non-AUTOPHYES characters.

name: Yearnlings
flavor: Once humanoid forms contorted to the shape of burrowing insects. Blind from lifetimes underground, they instead react to scent, vibration, and sound. Their approach is heralded by a clicking noise they make with their mouth-parts. First one, then three, then a dozen, a hundred.
attacks: Deal 2 damage to an adjacent creature
special_text: On any turn, sacrifice 2 Speed to Spawn 1 additional Yearnling adjacent to this one.

name: Singing Scythe
flavor: A flying manta ray made of skin and piano wire, these quick, flying creatures slice trees and old buildings to digestible sizes without slowing down. Their name comes from the musical whistling tones that emit from their permanently agape mouths as they dive upon their foes. Tags: Minion
attacks: Charge:7, Damage:5. Running into other units does not interrupt this Charge. Deal damage to all units run over or into by this attack, enemy or ally.
special_text: These creatures always count as having Aegis:5, ignoring terrain features and are treated as having +1 Elevation. They are immune to any attack that only targets adjacent units.

name: Slavering Maw
flavor: A seeping wound in the ground that looks bottomless, but seems to lead to an endless supply of foul creatures. Around its circumference sit a thousand teeth-like protrusions that always seem to be freshly dripping with a viscous fluid.
special_text: Spawning - At the end of the round, The Slavering Maw gains a Charge. On the GM’s turn, they may spend 1 Charge to spawn an AUTOPHYES Minion, or 5 Charges to spawn a miniboss.

Feed The Abyss - Enemies with the Minion tag who are knocked into a Slavering Maw are instantly killed and Spawning is disabled for a turn while the meal is swallowed. Slavering Maw immediately gains a charge.

name: Strategic Toxic Waste
flavor: The sheer variety of toxic substances available to the denizens of Hell are innumerable. Of course, it only made sense to group them all together into a kind of glowing soup and store them in loose barrels at regular intervals. What could possibly go wrong?
special_text: Nobody Could Have Predicted This: Destruction of these barrels will cause a Burst:3 Damage:5 explosion. In addition, it leaves behind a 3x3 square of Toxic Sludge that provides Healing:2 for AUTOPHYES units only.

name: Wireweal
flavor: The cavernous, soul-crushing greed has so poisoned the land that it regularly vomits forth tumors of covetous steel to protect and retain what it has taken by force.
special_text: Wall: Can be chained into a Swarm as an action, granting the whole swarm Cover:1 and moving along with them. While carrying the Wireweal, the Swarm may only make one attack per round total. They may drop the Wireweal at any time as a Movement action.
Wall:3, Damage:2 and applying Pin:1 anyone trapped within

name: Obizu
subtitle: THE LEVIATHAN REBORN
flavor: The Polyp tried in vain to share the gilded truth with its neighbors, but ignorance turns lavender to spears and humanity had learned long to fear those rising from the sea. Their Queen’s blood would awaken a dawnless age, and her rebirth foretold their infernal kingdoms.
attacks: Star:3, Damage:3 Gain 1 Snake for each target damaged by this attack.
Spend 3 Snake and either spawn a Nosos or Pschent unit adjacent to OBIZU, or gain 1 Sprawl.

When a player unit is completely encircled by OBIZU, deal damage equal to OBIZU’s current Sprawl and inflict Constrict:1. Player units with Constrict may not move on their turn, and take additional damage from all sources equal to their current Constrict. OBIZU may spend any amount of Snake during this attack to increase the damage inflicted by 1 per snake. This attack triggers automatically, and retriggers if OBIZU begins their turn encircling a player unit.
agnosia_text: Instantly convert all remaining Snake into Speed, reduce Speed by 1 each following round until OBIZU’s Speed reaches 5. OBIZU gains the following abilities:
OBIZU now gains health whenever a Consumed unit takes damage, equal to the damage taken.
OBIZU may now spend Snake before attacking to increase the damage of any attack by the amount of Snake spent.

OBIZU may now Consume adjacent allied units to gain 1 Snake. Consumed minions are instantly destroyed and leave the battlefield, minibosses follow all the same rules as player units, taking damage at the start of their turn until they leave the snake.

name: Many-Footed Serpent
flavor: In the age of the empty sky, the secret places of the earth were barren, but the secret places under the sea, where the Archon Belias laid their secret fortress opened its gates to strange eyes, and through its gnosis the soft creatures of the sea rose to see like Humans, and deeper still.
attacks: Using the Appendages’ current Sprawl as the range, attack a player unit, deal 6 damage to the unit and any other units within Burst:2.
Target a player unit within line of sight, remove an appendage and deal 5 damage +Sprawl to the target.
agnosia_text: Choros gains the following ability:
Once per turn, as a free action, when you are adjacent to an allied minion, you may devour it and create a new appendage with Sprawl equal to the devoured unit’s Sprawl.
special_text: The Many-Footed Serpent is a Scale:2 unit with 4 appendages sprouting out from it. Each Appendage begins at Sprawl:4, and each appendage has 2 Speed. Appendages lose 1 Sprawl for every attack with Breaker that targets them. Destroying an Appendage entirely by reducing it to 0 Sprawl instantly deals damage to Choros equal to 25% of its current HP. Appendages (either the ones this unit begins with or the ones they gain) attach to one of the borders of the unit, and the tile of appendage directly adjacent to the unit cannot move except to follow the movement of the unit itself.

name: Knotted Sovereigns
flavor: The Polyp retreated into their usurped sanctum, and touched the silver thread bundle at the heart of it and vanished from the Earth.
attacks: Charge:4, Damage:3. During Charge, this unit may move through its own allies. This unit may consume one such ally to gain 1 Charge.
Arc:3, Damage:3. For each unoccupied space in the Arc pattern, place 1 Egg.
agnosia_text: Deal 5 damage in Burst equal to units current Scale, then immediately remove this unit from play, replacing it with a Swarm, with enough units to fill Syllogos’s current scale.
special_text: At the start of this unit's turn, it may spend Charge to gain 1 Scale and -1 Speed for each Charge spent. This temporary buff is lost at the start of their next turn.

name: She-Who-Eats
flavor: When the Polyp’s flesh turned silver, she devoured their first shedding, and in this way she held inside the things they were, as they wore outside the things they would become.
attacks: Target an allied unit with sprawl within Range equal to this unit's current sprawl. Devour that unit and make an attack with damage and range equal to the devoured units Sprawl.

Arc, Charge equal to current sprawl, deal ramping damage (1 for the first tile moved through, 2 for the second, and so on). Deal an additional 4 damage to any unit completely surrounded by She-Who- Eats during this attack.
agnosia_text: Select up to 4 units within Range equal to this unit's Sprawl. Increase each of these unit’s Sprawl by 2.

name: Little Biters
flavor: Their flesh still holds the Monad’s scent, their bodies passing through his in their flawed ascension. A common ground that begs the question; what if their passage had ended him there and then? And what of our own ascension, had we failed to slay the beast?
attacks: Deal 2 damage to an adjacent target.
special_text: When creating a Swarm by Swarming with other Nosos units, units add their sprawl together rather than using the traditional movement and Swarm rules I.E. Two Nosos units swarming creates a Nosos Swarm with Sprawl:4. Otherwise use existing rules for HP and damage calculations or discuss with the table.

name: Spitters
flavor: In this flawed ascension they filled the waters with the blood of the pierced beast, who in his fury struck the iron from the flesh of man and left them bare and cold.
attacks: Range:8, Damage:3 Poison:2
special_text: Spitters may only move or attack during their turn.

name: Ouroboric Worms
flavor: Phasic creatures, locked in turmoil between realities. Their forms tore through the Monad, but their spirits flow in the great miasma. Never truly here. Never truly there. Forever shifting through metamorphic probabilities.
attacks: Deal 1 damage to an adjacent target.
special_text: When in a Swarm of at least 2 units, Autoblabes may swarm with Nosos units. When doing this, immediately make an attack with Arc and damage equal to the Nosos unit’s Sprawl. Destroy the Nosos unit afterwards.

name: Brood Nurse
flavor: Did She appear to them, as well? A Polyp Sophia, her arms clad in silver scales, a great serpent-polyp at her feet, there in Belias's hidden fortress? Did she whisper secrets to them, as she did us?
attacks: Range:3, Damage:1, Bleed:2
special_text: When striking a target with an existing negative status effect, place an egg adjacent to this unit.

name: Eggs
flavor: What dwells within the egg is unimportant; the egg will not hatch. It is you who stirs against the atom-fine shell, brittle and eager to crack. Does the egg contain salvation, a renewal for this illspawned world, or an end to it all, and peace through annihilation? What do you contain?
special_text: When this unit spawns it gains Count- down:2, when Countdown expires, remove the egg from play and spawn any minion tagged unit except for Nosos. Alternatively, add 1 to the Countdown, then spawn a Choros and remove the egg from play.

name: Dragon-Mind Altar
flavor: Not all who heard the Polyp rose up with lavender spears—the silent borborites chased the same primordial unity, and spoke the name of The Hidden One, the First Appearing One, and the Self-Generated thricenamed androgynous one. She who stands beside the Monad, who holds the womb that births the world. How Belias knew of her is a mystery—or perhaps, a false assumption. Heavenly Wisdom is not always so.
special_text: Dragon-Spawning - At the end of the round, Dragon-Mind Altar gains 1 Charge. On the GM’s turn, they may spend 1 Charge to begin Spawning a Nosos, or 3 to spawn a Lepis egg immediately. Nosos remains attached to the Asebes Spawner, growing 1 Scale each turn it is attached. The GM may choose to free the Nosos as its action on any turn following its spawn.

name: Pseudo-Ascended Choral
flavor: Remnants of the seabed, torn apart and granted will beyond its own reckoning. A tiny saklas, writhing in its agnoia, spitting reality-rending bile at random.
attacks: Remove 1 Uneasy Terrain within Burst:1. Target a player unit within Range:2, deal 1 damage and inflict Bleed:2
special_text: When a player unit moves within Burst:1, immediately interrupt their action and replace all Standard terrain within Burst:1 with Uneasy terrain.

name: Caim
subtitle: THE FIRST BLOODIED
flavor: When the Archons found themselves distracted with the arrival of Syzygos, CAIM found the opportunity to take vengeance for their slights against him. Baptised in their blood, CAIM dedicated himself to the pursuit of a furious justice and order.
attacks: Target:1, Range:4, remove all Wounds from the target and spawn Ixodes equal to wounds removed adjacent to either CAIM or the target.
Deal 6 to an adjacent enemy and move one of your factions Swarms within line of sight by up to that Swarm's speed.
Burst:1, Push:1. Any demons pushed back this way deal an additional Wound:1 on their next attack.
agnosia_text: When CAIM hits AGNOSIA, immediately teleport to a free space adjacent to the nearest Swarm. Reshape the Swarm into any shape, as long as the shape adheres to existing movement and placement rules. The Swarm may overlay or collide with player characters already in play. After placing the new Swarm, if any Swarm tiles collide with or overlay an existing player character, Break, and deal 5 damage to the player character. Reshaping the Swarm ignores movement penalties and elevation.
special_text: If CAIM has not moved since their last attack, their next attack causes Bleed:1.
Once per turn, when adjacent to a Swarm, CAIM can move to any square adjacent to that Swarm at no cost to its Speed.

name: Sloth
flavor: Demons that had finished their training right at the end of the Archonian conquests debuted to a new war with accolades but no experience. With ardor and command, MESI scour the battlefield for tumultuous purposes.
attacks: Select a Swarm anywhere on the TAC- COM map. Break the Swarm and deal 5 damage to a unit within the Swarm’s original range. You may sacrifice an additional unit to deal 1 more damage.

Spend your turn preparing an attack and gain 1 Anauros. Each subsequent turn, you may spend your turn preparing and generate an additional 1 Anauros. Movement while you have Anauros removes all stacks of Anauros immediately. On your turn you may spend all Anauros to place a Blast:2 box anywhere on the battlefield and deal 3 damage to all units within. For each Anauros spent, select one of the following effects:
agnosia_text: Sloth may transform into any other available miniboss from this or another faction, retaining the same HP as before its transformation.

name: Halcyon Chariot
flavor: Feeding a two-headed Acheronian stallion an unwilling thrall will lower its guard enough to yoke it to a golden chariot. The psychogenic bridle compels the beast to fervent compliance.
attacks: Place an adjacent unit on top of this one—that unit is Riding this one. While Riding, they move as a single unit using APOKROTOS's Speed. The Rider may trigger Apokrotos’s attacks on their turn. Apokrotos may carry up to 3 Minions or one Miniboss.
Charge:5, Damage:4. Sacrifice a Rider to deal 3 additional damage and inflict Bleed:2.
agnosia_text: Throw all passengers to an unoccupied space in Range:4. At the end of this next turn, Chariot deals 10 damage in Burst:4 and dies.

name: Graven Chirurgeon
flavor: Wielding a cursed splinter made from an Archon's bones, ASKLEPIOS are masters of psychic synchronization. They will distribute misery wherever they go with synaptic glee.
attacks: Target:1, Range:4. Remove all target's stacks of Wound to immediately trigger and tick down one Effect on the target a number of times equal to the stacks of Wound removed or the Effect's current stacks, whichever is lower.
Select a target within Line of Sight with an active Effect. Increase that Effect’s intensity by 1.
agnosia_text: Once AGNOSIA is triggered, any damage Asklepios recieves can be applied as Heal- ing to any allied unit in Range:5

name: Forsaken Union
flavor: Unsteady hoplites in plaster-white masks anointed in CAIM's own blood, ANEMOS share a psychic link that is strongest when they are shoulder-to-shoulder.
attacks: Deal 2 damage to an adjacent creature.
special_text: When part of a Swarm, once per turn Forsaken Union can sacrifice up to half of the Swarm to inflict Bleed:1 to an adjacent unit for each unit sacrificed, and move up to that Speed as a free action.

name: Condemned Thrall
flavor: Originally ticks found in the gardens of their labyrinth, IXODES have been mutated and repurposed as sacrifices in the name of Greater demons.
attacks: Deal 1 Damage and apply Bleed:1 to an adjacent unit. Additionally, you may sacrifice this unit to leave a Blood Tile. Any Metricos unit that ends its movement in this tile gains 5 Temporary HP, removing the tile.
special_text: Ixodes can only form a Swarm with a Miniboss or Boss unit, and only one IXODES may be in a given Swarm. You may sacrifice Ixodes to negate one attack against or to remove one debuff from a unit in the Swarm.

name: Crimson Gust
flavor: Rustwinds howl like nightmares, the ground wells with red ichor. The blood behind your eyes begins to pulsate. The veins in your hands set in motion a cowards revolt.
attacks: Range:1, Target:1, Damage:2
special_text: When this unit dies, apply Wound:1 to all enemies in Burst:1

name: Bloodletter
flavor: The Body Keeps Score.
attacks: Range:1 Damage:1. Apply 1 bleed to target. If this target has any Wound, deal 1 additional damage and inflict Bleed:1

name: Hemarula
flavor: By reducing the blood of a 10000 demons into its rawest minerals, Metricosian alchemists have crafted an everlasting catalyst to summon their fellow demons wherever needed. Compressed into a clean marble altar, it is searing hot and constantly steaming at the touch of its attendants, cleansing it constantly with bloody cloths.
special_text: At the end of the round, Hemarula gains a Charge. On the GM’s turn, they may spend 1 Charge to spawn a Metricos minion, or 5 Charges to spawn a miniboss.
When Manned, any unit spawned by Hemarula gains 2 additional Speed.

name: Leech Mire
flavor: With careful wrangling, the megaleeches of the thymosian springs can be tactically deployed to the battlefield. Each of these tamed leeches is as large and ravenous as an adult swine.
special_text: The Leech Mire’s zone of control can be moved through by any unit as if it were Uneasy Terrain. HELLPIERCERS take 2 damage when they leave the zone of control, and gain Slow:2.

Every time a Leech Mire deals damage, it gains 1 stack of Blood Quenched. During your turn, any Metricos unit moving into the Leech Mire’s Zone of Control may spend 1 stack of Blood Quenched to heal 50% of their current HP. This does not undo AGNOSIA states.

name: Bloodspear Ballista
flavor: A ballista crafted from the bones of murdered Archons. Its bleached white surface is speckled only with the rapid spooling of bloodkrill silk. Marksmen will often jest that in the right hands you could lance a target in heaven.
attacks: Bleed:2, Damage:2 and create a Blood- line between the Ballista and a target. Passing through this Bloodline deals 2 Damage to any unit that does so, and heals any Metricos unit within Range:2. The driver may recall the bloodline and bring back whatever it hit.

name: Bloodshield Phalanx
flavor: Early blood sages developed a technique that takes advantage of blood coagulation to create a shield. That skill is replicated into a specialized device that spreads a bloodshield over a large area to protect their troops.
special_text: Sacrifice a unit into the central generator to increase its scale by 1. Its scale decreases by 1 at the end of your turn. Bloodshield provides Cover: 1 to any unit within its influence.

name: Orobas
subtitle: THE SPEAKER
flavor: The herald of the Paracletus and the first to pour from the Source Seed, OROBAS sees the world around it for what it could be. It does not want to kill you—it wants to free you.
attacks: Line:4. If the target is on a Stained square, deal 8 damage. Otherwise deal 3 damage.
Deal 5 damage to an adjacent unit. If it kills that creature, spawn one new miniboss of your choosing under your control.
Move any unit adjacent to any stained square onto that stained square, and deal that unit 5 damage.
agnosia_text: Immediately spawn any one unique fortification within 5 squares of OROBAS.
special_text: When OROBAS takes damage, you may increase that damage by 1 to Stain an adjacent square.
Stainwalk
When on a Stained square, OROBAS moves twice as fast.

name: Eyesting Rose
flavor: When the Source Seed was experimenting with fractals, PRISTIR was born. Those that try to trace its patterns may lose track of its size and subsequent threat.
attacks: Increase PRISTIR’s scale by 2. Any occupied spaces take 5 damage and are pushed out.
Deal 10 damage to Burst:1, then decrease PRISTIR’s scale by 1.
agnosia_text: Increase PRISTIR’s scale by 1 and PRIS- TIR is now Primed. Any occupied spaces take 5 damage and are pushed out.
special_text: Stainwalk
When PRISTIR is on Stain, allies on connected Stained squares take 2 less damage when attacked.and PRISTIR takes 2 more damage when attacked.

name: Gorgenaut
flavor: Formed at the Scyllan Convergence of thirteen seas, RETIARIUS is bent on consumption. By swirling its energy in a Charybdic array pattern, it generates a near-inescapable vacuum.
attacks: Cone:3. Deal 5 damage and pull any unit 1 space towards RETIARIUS.
Deal 10 damage to an adjacent unit. Move that unit to any stained square.
agnosia_text: Draw a 5x5 box with RETIARIUS at the center and Stain them. Pull any enemies within the box 1 square towards RE- TIARIUS.
special_text: Stainwalk
When RETIARIUS is on a Stained square, it recovers 10 HP at the end of your turn.

name: Soaring Bombardier
flavor: When the stain washed over a stygian anemone, it rose to flight in the form of CHALAZAOR. Its volatile spawn are said to be irremovable when planted.
attacks: Create a Flowerbud on an adjacent square with 1 HP and Countdown:2. When the timer reaches 0, it blooms into a Stain Flower.
Deal 3 damage and Bleed:2 to an adjacent unit.
agnosia_text: CHALAZOR emits a hypnotic pattern of colors that mortal eyes weren’t meant to see. Countdown:10. Whenever CHALA- ZOR would take damage, it takes 0 damage instead and reduces Countdown by 1. When Countdown reaches zero, CHALAZOR dies and deals 5 damage to Burst:2.

name: Lurking Freak
flavor: Direct descendant of some of the first beings spawned from the Source Seed and the catalyst for the Contagion Mind, POTAGON once saw to the safety of the Seed on its journey through the rivers of Hell until it reached its nest in the depths.
attacks: Range:2, Line:4 Damage:4, and stain targeted squares.
Deal 10 damage to an adjacent unit, and target gets Pinned:1.
agnosia_text: POTAGON burrows into the ground and counts as Stained ground for other units to occupy.
special_text: Stainwalk
When POTAGON ends its turn on a square that isn’t stained, it takes 10 HP damage.

name: Scorned Eyes
flavor: When the Source Seed purged parasites from its body, they arose a new Stained being. The Contagion Mind deemed KATA- GOS more useful, integrating them into their own sub-link of the mind network.
attacks: Damage:2, Range:1
special_text: When a Swarm contains 4 or more units, a Swarm may Prime itself. Any Swarm that is Primed will destroy the entire Swarm when taking damage, leaving any spaces they occupied with the Stained condition.

name: Stain Creep
flavor: Sentient stain that walked before it could think. Nearby creatures will hear a constant ringing—a comfort for the Paracletus but a source of unease for everyone else.
attacks: Deal 4 damage to an adjacent creature.
special_text: If a Stain Creep ends its turn on a square that isn’t Stained, it dies.
Stainwalk
Allied units can inhabit the same square as Stain Creep.

name: Shadowing Witness
flavor: When the Source Seed bleeds during a hurricane, AULAEA are formed in the foamy waters. It's rumored that their intense gaze can relieve headaches in humans—an uncanny ability some see as a boon instead of an omen.
attacks: Range:2, Damage:2
special_text: When AULAEA leaves a square, it counts as stained until your next turn.

name: Latent Pudding
flavor: In the pressures of the deep sea, compressed Paraclesal flesh will roil and condense into an AMBROID. AMBROID will sing an alien aria before they turn into a new weapon on the terrain.
attacks: Push:2
special_text: When ending its turn on a Stained tile, Latent Pudding may transform into any Paracletus Fortification.

name: Paracletus Loom
flavor: The creation of Paracletal spinnerets connected to the Source Seed with a transpatial superequation can transport demons across great demons almost instantaneously. Each being in the Contagion Mind acts as a roller on a conveyor belt to move their presence along.
special_text: At the end of the round, Paracletus Loom gains a Charge. On the GM’s turn, they may spend 1 Charge to spawn a Paracletus minion, or 5 Charges to spawn a miniboss.

name: Stain Flower
flavor: In corrupting the Fibonacci sequence with Paraclesal mathematics, seeds injected into the battlefield can bloom into viable standins for lower level demons. Swarms including a Stain Flower will notice an empty presence in the Contagion Mind that merely echoes the units it is linked with.
special_text: These pods count as part of a Swarm when next to any minions without joining them. They cannot move or take any action, and have 1 HP.

name: Stain Geyser
flavor: By adjusting the flow of subterranean stain rivers, they may bore upwards into a geyser on the surface. The stain travels through the earth in a helix pattern, erupting in an efficient and beautiful fractal array.
special_text: Draw a 4x4 square around Stain Geyser. This area is stained while the Stain Geyser exists.

name: Creep Station
flavor: By using a modified version of the transpatial superequation, the Contagion Mind links two Paraclesal cubes on the battlefield. When boarded, the occupants of one cube will safely be launched to a linked cube at a high speed.
special_text: Draw a line of squares between any two Creep Stations. This line cannot pass through any obstacles or void tiles. Any unit may board on one Creep Station and arrive at a connected Creep Station at the beginning of their next turn. Units on the line while the Creep Station is being used take 10 damage.

name: Bubbling Presence
flavor: A bubble made out of stain, containing a lightweight gas that can redisperse into stain when popped. It accepts a single command before being excised from the Contagion Mind.
special_text: Creates a bubble of stain that drifts in a single direction. If it hits an obstacle, unit, or is attacked, it bursts, deals 3 damage in Burst:1, and creates stain in every targetted tile.

name: Amdusias
subtitle: THE RELUCTANT SLUMBERER
flavor: Also known as the Great Somnambulist. Her demonic court endeavors to keep her amused and awake at all times, but her exhaustion is entropic. The closer to sleep she gets, the harder she rages. Once she falls asleep, none can stop her movements.
attacks: Charge, Arc: 9,. Damage:4. Shatter: 8 damage. Shattered units gain Shock:1.
Range:3. Damage:3. Targeted unit is Frozen:1. Shatter: 3 damage. Repeat this attack against another target within range of this unit’s remaining movement for the turn.
agnosia_text: AMDUSIAS begins to rouse through bleary eyes. She bellows ferociously inflicting Pin:1 on all units who can hear in

range:3 as she grows to Scale:2. She adopts a bestial visage with hoarfrost claws and crystaline fangs. End Slumber Phase and Enter Thrashing Phase as AM- DUSIAS fights against the return of The Slumber.
special_text: Thrashing Phase
Line:5 Width:3. Damage:5. Shatter: 7 damage. Create uneasy terrain in Burst:1 of all shattered units, then they suffer Push:1.
Range:1, Damage:4. Shatter: 8 Damage. Unit gains Compel:2.
Burst:3. Damage:3. Shatter: 5 damage. Inflict Bleed:2. If this attack Shattered any units, this attack gains Lingering for damage spaces within Burst:2.
Whenever a unit on the battlefield is Frozen, gain one Charge. Charge may be spent as follows:
3 Charge: Next attack gains Transference.
2 Charge (only after AGNOSIA): Revert to Slumbering Phase. AGNOSIA value is now half this unit’s current HP.
1 Charge: Pick a unit. The next attack on this unit that triggers Shatter does not remove any stacks of Frozen.
8 Charge: The next attack against all units that trigger Shatter does not remove any stacks of Frozen.
12 Charge: Detonate all stacks of Frozen on all units. They take damage equal to twice their Frozen value. Reapply Frozen:1 to all units. This reapplication does not provide any Charges.
AMDUSIAS begins combat in Slumbering Phase. While in Slumbering Phase, AMDUSIAS cannot be affected by nonstandard terrain types or Slowed.
Slumbering Phase

Place three dreamform nodes within range 5. All creatures within Burst:1 of these nodes are Frozen:3. Any units who enter Burst:1 of the nodes are likewise frozen. AMDUSIAS may move to any of these nodes once per turn without spending any movement. Other units may not occupy the same space of the nodes. AM- DUSIAS may have a maximum of 4 nodes total. Placing nodes beyond the 4th will require erasing a prior node.

name: The Nightmare Shaken Off
flavor: A hunched beast shrouded in wet fur. They lash out sporadically and with surprising speed. Beneath their matted fur, a hollow chest cavity blows freezing, gale-force winds at all times.
attacks: Blast:2, Range:3, Damage:5. Apply Frozen: 1. Shatter: 10 damage. The Nightmare Shaken Off immediately moves adjacent to any shattered target, if able. Frozen is not applied to any units affected by the attack.
Burst:1, Damage:4. Shatter: 4 damage. Push:1. Repeat the attack, increasing Burst by one. Repeat until this attack does not shatter any units.
agnosia_text: All of this unit’s Shatter effects also inflict Pin:1.

name: Bell Ringers
flavor: These demons are often seen listlessly moving across battlefields, toying with the gong mallets they carry. When they find an ally has fallen asleep or an enemy is open they strike with all their might.
attacks: Deal 1 damage to an Adjacent creature.
Range:1, Damage:1. Shatter: Deal 5 damage. One of Kodon’s allies gains Haste:1.

name: Shivering Masses
flavor: Rhigos are easily identified by their constant shaking, not with fear, but with cold. They huddle together in masses for warmth. The unlucky fall asleep and are cast back into the cold.
attacks: Deal 3 damage to an adjacent creature.
Line:4. All creatures in range gain Frozen:1.

name: Wall Of Ice
flavor: Mountain dwelling demons known to fall asleep in narrow mountain passes. Their shock at waking sends them into a frenzy which demolishes carefully carved paths across treacherous mountain terrain.
attacks: Wall:3, Range:1, Damage:3. All damaged units gain: Frozen:1.
Burst:2 Damage:3. Shatter: 5 damage. This unit gains Armor:1.
special_text: While Armored this unit has Scale:2 and deals additional damage equal to its Armor rating.

name: Ice-In-The-Veins
flavor: These vampiric scavengers are often found in the wake of battles between demonic forces. They feast on the diamond dust of shattered bloody corpses. The warmth of fresh blood keeps them from nodding into sleep when sated.
attacks: Blast:2, Range:4, Damage:2. All enemies in range gain Frozen:1 Bleeding enemies instead gain Frozen:3.
Range:5 Damage:1 Shatter: 5 damage. This unit gains Transference:1.
special_text: Bleeding units count as Frozen for the purposes of Shatter effects.

name: Ice Glider
flavor: A sleek figure with billowing wings who locomotes by freezing a trail in the air ahead of them. That these trails disintegrate in the wake of the ice glider has made them favored scouts of the armies of Theletus.
attacks: Blast:3 Range:3. All units in blast range gain Frozen:2
Charge:8 Damage:2. Shatter: 5 damage. This unit may choose a new direction to continue the charge while gaining no additional spaces of movement for the charge.
special_text: This unit does not trigger harmful or negative terrain effects while Charging.

name: Hatchling
flavor: Ambush hunters from the frozen depths of THELETUS lands. Their penchant for playful ambush of other demons has led to a culture of pre-emptively freezing Hatchlings before they can cause too much trouble. Vigilance for Hatchling ambush often keeps THELETUS night watches alert and on edge.
attacks: Damage:2, Range:1. If this unit was frozen before making this attack, apply Frozen:1 to target.
special_text: If this unit is Frozen, it may make a free attack, ending frozen status, against any unit which moves within range:3.

name: Blooder
flavor: These small and vastly-fanged demons survive by drawing warmth from the blood of their victims. They leave their victims too numbed from the cold they radiate for them to notice the splitting of their flesh.
attacks: Range:2, Damage:2. Shatter: 4 damage. Bleed:2.

name: The Myoclonic Awakening Chamber
flavor: An enormous and icy chrysalis holds a captain of THELETUS who gave into the Slumber too early. In time, the earth will crack like a body jerking to reject sleep and the warrior will spill forth from the wound.
special_text: Spawning - Whenever a unit gains Frozen within range: 5, this unit gains one Charge. Five Charges can be spent to spawn a THELETUS miniboss. After spawning, this unit dies.
Glacial Rending - When the Myoclonic Awakening Chamber dies, its body falls to ruin and its death spasm becomes an avalanche. All units within Range:3 take 8 damage and gain Frozen:3.

name: Singing Nexus
flavor: Ice threaded and pulled like glass form a tower which cradles a slumbering babe suspended in meters of frozen dreamstuff. The tower sways more erratically the colder it gets. Eventually the tower rights itself, sloughing off freezing air in impossible concentrations.
special_text: Frigid Amplifier: this ability triggers whenever the Singing Nexus is within range of any effect which inflicts Frozen. For the purposes of Frozen effects it takes, the singing Nexus counts as an enemy unit, but takes no damage from the triggering action. At the end of the current combat round, if this fortification has taken any stacks of Frozen this round, it triggers a Burst: 5 effect where it can distribute twice its current Frozen rating as stacks of the Frozen effect among any enemies in the Burst.

name: Bell of Awakening
flavor: An enormous brass bell cold forged and pressed to shape by the monastic scientists of the Clangorous Abbey. Reliefs on the bell's surface depict the breaking of the first light of dawn on a gathering crowd. Grooves and scratches from repeated, violent ringings have obscured the faces of the congregation.
special_text: Atavistic Toll: After taking damage from any unit, the Bell of Awakening rings out. All THELETUS units capable of hearing it immediately gain Haste:1. Bell of Awakening gains Countdown:2, and may only trigger Atavistic Toll after the Countdown ends.

This faction cannot be chosen as one of the three at the start of the game. Instead, this faction acts as a collection of units that any existing faction can draw from. They lack many of the special upgrades and map-based mechanics of the other factions, but by teaming up with their more prestigious cousins they can create complex, surprising combat encounters.

name: Morax
subtitle: OF THE BROKEN HORN
flavor: Once a great king of their own domain, commanding a thousand Hell Legions, their horn was broken in the first war, and their magic greatly reduced. Still, the flames of their long lost home still burns in the craven hole where their heart would be.
attacks: Charge:5. If Morax collides with a player, deal the remaining Charge as damage. Any squares Morax moves through during this charge become Primed.
Detonate all Primed spaces. Deal 5 damage to any units standing on the tiles, and 2 damage to any adjacent units.
Deal 5 damage to one unit adjacent to Morax, and Prime the two spaces on either side of the damaged unit.
agnosia_text: Select a type of Minion and remove them from the battle. Detonate all Primed spaces. Allied units and other demons within Burst:2 recover HP equal to the number of removed minions, while HELLPIERCER units within Burst:2 take damage equal to the number of removed minion units. Morax gains the following:
All tiles Primed by Morax gain Count- down:3. When Countdown reaches zero, the Primed tile detonates, dealing 5 damage to any units standing on the tile, and 2 damage to any adjacent units.
special_text: At the start of their turn, Morax may Un- prime 3 tiles to summon either 3 minions from the EKKLESIA faction, or one miniboss from any demon faction currently in play.

name: Hedist’s Bane
flavor: A revered warlock, once. Summoned by a great warrior during the War in Heaven, their betrayal claimed the lives of thousands, and the souls of thousands more. Now a mere shade, a memory of their former power still drives a bestial cruelty.
attacks: Deal 3 damage to a creature within Range:2. If the attacked creature is on a square with no terrain effects, Prime that square.
Move immediately to a Primed square, remove the Mark, and Burst:2 for 2 damage.
agnosia_text: Gain 3 Hold. At any point during your actions, spend Hold to Prime a square within line of sight.

name: Requiem Acolyte
flavor: Along their ragged band follows their acolytes—the adherents, the professional profaners, eager to elevate through self-denigration. Their lives are batteries of faith for their fallen kings.
attacks: Range:4, Damage:3. When the attack’s target next moves onto a Primed space, unprime that space and choose one:
agnosia_text: When this unit deals damage, Prime the nearest unoccupied space.

name: Burdened Ones
flavor: Jewelless crowns, shattered scepters, legless thrones, and mothworn robes. Their vertebrae strain to haul the corpse of magnificence before the crawling worms that puppet their future.
attacks: Range:1 Damage:4. Targeted unit gains Enrage:1.
Burst:2 Damage:2. Enemy units damaged gain Enrage:1. If more than one enemy was damaged by this attack, Enrage targets must be other enemy units damaged by this attack.
agnosia_text: All units with Armor gain Transfer- ence:1 on all of their attacks.
special_text: When this unit ends its turn, all adjacent allied units gain Armor:3 and Compel:1.

name: The Proscribed Dead
flavor: Ghosts, lesser devils, demons, and shadows whose names have been stricken from the Book, and their faces scratched from the Narsis Chambers. Thrown like stones into the river of violence.
attacks: Deal 2 damage to an adjacent creature.
special_text: Instead of attacking, a Proscribed Dead Swarm may spend one unit to place a Prime marker in its place or convert an adjacent Primed space into one of the following terrain options:

name: Kreas
flavor: Most of course are not "Once great" or "Revered upon a time". Most are wretches, barely noticed when they marched under the banner of glory and gold, barely noticed now they walk beneath tatters and ruin.
attacks: Deal 0 damage to an adjacent creature. That creature gains Shock:1.
special_text: When this unit dies, it respawns in the open space nearest where it died after 2 turns of combat.
Allied units adjacent to this unit may take a Main Action to consume this unit. This unit dies and the consuming unit gains 10 HP.

name: The Muses
flavor: Beezlebub brought music to Hell. For a brief moment, the eternal screams formed something that resembled rhapsody. They killed him for it, and now his muses sing only requiems
attacks: Burst:5 Damage:0. Allied units in the burst deal +2 Damage on their next attack.
special_text: When this unit dies, Prime the space it was occupying. The next allied unit to move onto this space gains Haste:1.

name: Diphros
flavor: The only difference between the drivers, and those being driven, is who has the right to hold the whip. They serve the same masters, and by becoming their lord's punitive hand, the enforcers become agents of power, exchanging will for power. Chains they do not hear. Lashes they cannot feel.
attacks: Deal 2 damage to an Adjacent creature.
special_text: When this unit passes adjacent to an ally during movement, that allied unit may move in the same direction as this unit for the rest of its movement.

name: The Bog Kings
flavor: Mocked even at their supremacy, a gaggle of pretenders and would-have-beens. Brought low by Beezlebub's revolution, and lower still by its tragic ruination. They believe they crawl on their bellies through some cosmic alignment of misjustice, and so they're always surrounded by lackeys, ready to be sacrificed on the altars of their egos.
attacks: Range:4, Blast:2, Damage:1. If any primed tiles are within the blast of this unit’s attack, the tile unprimes and all tiles in Burst:1 of the primed tile become uneasy terrain as a fountain of liquid gold swamp erupts on the spot. Any units occupying these tiles when they become uneasy take 2 damage and gain Blazing:1.
special_text: Instead of attacking, this Swarm may spend one unit to cause a swamp of liquid gold to burst forth from the ground in Burst:1 of the spent unit’s location. These tiles are uneasy terrain. Any enemy units in the burst take 2 damage and gain Blazing:1.

name: Spawning Pit
flavor: Sentient souls laboriously ground into a fine paste and mixed with enchanted mud. A fertile slurry for clawing horror.
special_text: Spawning - At the end of the round, Spawning Pit gains a Charge. On the GM’s turn, they may spend 1 Charge to spawn a minion from any currently active faction, or 5 Charges to spawn a miniboss.

name: Pleroma Barrel
flavor: A hellsteel drum of condensed pleroma. HELLPIERCER weapons are consecrated with Gnosis, and the explosive force of mass ascension can be deadly to creatures too close to the blast zone.
special_text: When this fortification reaches 0 HP, instantly Burst:2 and deal 5 HP damage to all creatures within range

name: Weapon Emplacement
flavor: “You’ve seen them too; ghosttrails, floaters— each of us leaves a residual trail through Psi-Space, even when we’re undosed. These things stay connected just enough to pick up on those trails and respond.” - Phantasikos Sari
attacks: Line:4, Damage:3
